name: Dallas Lawrence
office: Las Virgenes Unified School District, Governing Board Member

items.text: Dallas Lawrence has served on the Las Virgenes Unified School District Board of Education since 2013. He says he previously served as a director at the U.S. Department of Education and a Navy officer.

sentences.text: Dallas Lawrence has served on the Las Virgenes Unified School District Board of Education since 2013.
He says he previously served as a director at the U.S. Department of Education and a Navy officer.

items.text: His campaign says he wants to address student mental health and close the academic achievement gap. It also says that as board president after the Parkland shooting, he led the district to invest more than $1 million in school safety.
